title: Nation Building
headline: One identity. Different ways to meet people.
description: Selected digital communication and merchandise applications brought together as a single visual system.

story.caption: Digital artwork connects the name, message and visual language.
The identity applied to a fabric tote.
Buttons and a key fob extend the system into smaller formats.
The mark in material and everyday contexts.
A shared name and visual language connect screen and merchandise.
Selected applications brought together as a family.

decisions.title: A recognisable anchor
decisions.text: The Nation Building name and typographic treatment connect the digital artwork with the physical applications.

decisions.title: Composed for the format
decisions.text: Layouts change between posters, fabric, circular buttons and a narrow key fob, while keeping the identity recognisable.

decisions.title: Shown in context
decisions.text: The presentation pairs artwork with applications so the relationship between the graphic and the object is easy to see.

title: Telangana Manifesto
headline: A publication, seen as a whole.
description: A visual study of publication structure, information hierarchy and the rhythm between text, colour and imagery.
scope: Publication design · Information hierarchy · Editorial layout

story.caption: The opening sequence establishes categories and colour.
Hierarchy guides the reader through dense policy content.
Text and photography create a change of pace.
A consistent structure holds different sections together.
A content spread balances reading space and visual context.
Selected pages show the publication’s overall rhythm.

decisions.title: Hierarchy before detail
decisions.text: Headings, colour bands and grouping separate the promises and policy content into a readable sequence.

decisions.title: A consistent page structure
decisions.text: Repeated type relationships and margins connect sections with different amounts of text.

decisions.title: Room for a change of pace
decisions.text: Photographs and larger visual moments interrupt dense pages and give the publication a more varied rhythm.

title: LED Rath Yatra
headline: Graphics across a moving surface.
description: A communication system adapted to the side, front and rear of an LED vehicle, with space for the screen and multiple language treatments.
scope: Vehicle graphics · Surface adaptation · Multilingual composition

story.caption: Side elevations show the message around the LED aperture.
Front and rear treatments continue the communication system.
One language treatment, adapted to the vehicle surface.
An alternate script preserves the visual hierarchy.
Typography and imagery frame the screen opening.
The vehicle system shown across multiple views.

decisions.title: Design around the screen
decisions.text: The LED aperture is treated as a fixed constraint. Typography, portraits and message areas occupy the surrounding surfaces.

decisions.title: A system across elevations
decisions.text: Side, front and rear views continue the same visual language while responding to different proportions.

decisions.title: Hierarchy across scripts
decisions.text: Language variants retain the structure and emphasis of the composition while accommodating different scripts.

title: Samvidhan Gaurav Abhiyaan
headline: A deck with a visual rhythm.
description: A presentation system using section openers, portraits, quotations and changes in contrast to organise a long narrative.
scope: Presentation design · Story sequencing · Editorial composition

story.caption: A contents page establishes the narrative structure.
A portrait-led opener introduces a new section.
Portrait, quotation and supporting text form a clear hierarchy.
Light and dark layouts vary the reading rhythm.
A visual pause signals the chapter change.
Selected slides demonstrate continuity across the deck.

decisions.title: Structure first
decisions.text: The contents page and section openers make the sequence of the presentation visible before the detailed slides.

decisions.title: A clear focal point
decisions.text: Portraits, quotations and supporting text use changes in scale and position to establish a reading order.

decisions.title: Contrast as a chapter cue
decisions.text: Light and dark backgrounds, colour changes and image-led pauses distinguish sections without losing continuity.
